Messages.Author: Jozxyqk
Messages.Body:
Fidus has "-1 strength."
Does this mean that his base strength is 0 (1 - 1), or
that his base strength is -1 (literally, -1 strength)?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Like +1 strength, -1 strength is a modifier.
